text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF draws near. Standing before 
the stage where generations of Tiara 
Umamusume had once fought, Rhein Kraft was 
tingling with anticipation and excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she confronted Daring Heart. 
From Daring Heart, she sensed an aura like 
a sharply honed, straight spear...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft felt momentarily overwhelmed 
by the pressure. However, bracing herself 
once more, she headed out toward the race—
